description: This file is a shell script library for testing the git-daemon component, providing functions to start and stop the daemon, manage prerequisites, and facilitate simple network communication via a custom netcat implementation.

methods.name: start_git_daemon
methods.description: Starts the git daemon with specified options, ensuring it's not already running and setting up necessary environment like FIFO and cleanup handlers.

methods.name: stop_git_daemon
methods.description: Stops the running git daemon, performing cleanup and error handling based on its exit status.

methods.name: fake_nc
methods.description: A minimalistic netcat-like function to connect to a host:port, send stdin data, and output the response.
